in_marathi.name: Vishwajit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vishwajit is derived from the Sanskrit words Vishwa, meaning 'world' or 'universe', and Jit, meaning 'conqueror' or 'victor'. This name signifies a person who has conquered the universe or all aspects of life, and is often associated with the deity Vishwakarma, the divine architect and creator of the universe.
